modal.title: Report a platform issue
modal.intro: MultiPost relies on adapters tied to each platform's UI. When a platform ships a redesign, publishing can break. Tell us what you saw and we'll prioritize the fix. If you can help maintain the adapter, contributions are very welcome.
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: What you tried, what went wrong, how often it happens, and what you'd like us to fix.
modal.contributeHint: Interested in maintaining the extension or desktop adapters? Read the
modal.anonymousNote: We attach your account info so we can follow up. It is not made public.

toast.failureDescription: Please retry later or reach out through in-app support.
